entries.title: Idle crewmates keep orbiting on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, an idle crewmate the app has not heard from lately, such as a reviewer waiting on its builder, no longer stands still and faded. It orbits and circles the work it waits on, as it does on your Mac. Only a computer out of reach still holds its crew still.
entries.noPicture: This changes motion, which a still picture of the scene cannot show.
